    #define __QBFC_EXTERN

#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))

/*******************************************************************/
/* _64_BIT_TIME is not defined before 7.2, and is dependent on     */
/* the definition of time64_t.                                     */
/*******************************************************************/
#if ((__OS400_TGTVRM__<720) || !(defined __time64_t))       /* @A6A*/
#undef _64_BIT_TIME                                         /* @A6A*/
#endif                                                      /* @A6A*/

/* ================================================================= */
/* utimbuf structure definition                                      */
/* ================================================================= */
struct utimbuf {
#ifndef _64_BIT_TIME             /* Standard definitions         @A6A*/
  time_t     actime;             /*  access time        */
  time_t     modtime;            /*  modification time  */
#else                            /* 64-bit definitions           @A6A*/
  time64_t   actime;             /*  access time                 @A6A*/
  time64_t   modtime;            /*  modification time           @A6A*/
#endif                           /* 64-bit definitions           @A6A*/
};

QBFC_EXTERN int utime(const char *, const struct utimbuf *);

/* Protect POSIX source                                        @A4A*/
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))
                                                            /* @A4A*/
QBFC_EXTERN int QlgUtime(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,
			 const struct utimbuf *);

/* Protect POSIX source                                        @A4A*/
#endif

/***********************************************************************/
/* Add 64-bit interfaces in 7.2 and later releases. These also depend  */
/* on the definition of time64_t.                                      */
/***********************************************************************/
#if ((__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720) && (defined __time64_t))           /* @A6A*/

/***********************************************************************/
/* 64-bit time utimbuf structure                                       */
/***********************************************************************/
struct utimbuf_time64 {                                         /* @A6A*/
  time64_t   actime;             /*  access time                   @A6A*/
  time64_t   modtime;            /*  modification time             @A6A*/
};                                                              /* @A6A*/

QBFC_EXTERN int utime_time64(const char *,
                             const struct utimbuf_time64 *);    /* @A6A*/

#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))     /* @A6A*/
QBFC_EXTERN int QlgUtime_time64(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,
                                const struct utimbuf_time64 *); /* @A6A*/
#endif                                                          /* @A6A*/

/***********************************************************************/
/* Map utime APIs to 64-bit versions if _64_BIT_TIME is defined        */
/***********************************************************************/
#ifdef _64_BIT_TIME                                             /* @A6A*/
#pragma map (utime, "utime_time64")                             /* @A6A*/
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))     /* @A6A*/
  #pragma map (QlgUtime, "QlgUtime64_time64")                   /* @A6A*/
 #endif                                                         /* @A6A*/
#endif                                                          /* @A6A*/
#endif                                                          /* @A6A*/
